```yaml
name: Deploy Website

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main" ]

jobs:
  build-and-deploy:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    
    steps:
    - name: Checkout Code
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
    - name: Setup PowerShell
      uses: actions/setup-powershell@v2
      
    - name: Install Dependencies
      run: |
        # Install required modules if needed
        if (!(Get-Module -ListAvailable -Name PSWriteOffice)) {
          Install-Module PSWriteOffice -Force -Scope CurrentUser
        }
        
    - name: Build Website
      shell: pwsh
      run: |
        $psWriteOfficePath = "C:\Support\GitHub\PSWriteOffice"
        if (!(Test-Path $psWriteOfficePath)) {
          $psWriteOfficePath = ".\PSWriteOffice"
        }
        ./Website/build.ps1 -SkipBuildTool -CI -PSWriteOfficeRoot $psWriteOfficePath
        
    - name: Validate Website
      shell: pwsh
      run: |
        # Add validation steps here if needed
        Write-Host "Website validation completed successfully"
        
    - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
      uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v4
      with:
        github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        publish_dir: ./Website/_site
        publish_branch: gh-pages
        user_name: 'github-actions[bot]'
        user_email: 'github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
        commit_message: 'Deploy website updates'
        
    - name: Deploy to Cloudflare Pages (if secrets available)
      if: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN != '' && secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID_OFFICEIMO != '' }}
      uses: cloudflare/wrangler-action@v3
      with:
        apiToken: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
        accountId: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
        workingDirectory: ./Website
        command: pages deploy ./_site --project-name officeimo-website
```
